description: This is a Java test class (ApiVerificationTest) that verifies API classes within the Fineract project. It checks that API classes follow naming conventions ('ApiResource') and are versioned correctly (with paths starting with /vN/). It utilizes Jersey for resource management and Spring for context and annotations.

classes.name: ApiVerificationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies API class naming conventions and versioning within the Fineract project.

methods.name: testAllApiClassesAreNamedAsApiResource
methods.description: Tests that all registered API classes have names ending with 'ApiResource'.

methods.name: verifyApiNaming
methods.description: Helper method to verify that an API class name ends with 'ApiResource'.

methods.name: testAllApisAreVersioned
methods.description: Checks that all API classes are versioned, i.e., have paths starting with /vN/.

methods.name: verifyApiIsVersioned
methods.description: Helper method that verifies an API class path conforms to versioning standards.

methods.name: isApi
methods.description: Determines if a class is an API class by checking for a @Path annotation.

methods.name: getPathAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves the @Path annotation from a class if present.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes and concatenates base paths and sub-paths to form full API paths.
